parties.respondent: State of Andhra Pradesh, Department of Revenue & Ors.

summary: Land title dispute; origin in 1943 mortgage; court auction in 1970; private purchase and sale; possession by appellants; resumption by government for public purpose (DIET center); patta land vs assigned land; non-alienability; resumption under executive order; applicability of Section 80 CPC; reliance on Pattadar Passbook under Andhra Pradesh Act, 1971; burden of proof in suits against government; admissibility of oral evidence; claim of uninterrupted possession; challenge to validity of resumption without compensation; judicial review of executive resumption; protection of private rights in government-assigned land.
legal_provisions_cited: Andhra Pradesh (Record of Rights in Land and Pattadar Pass Books) Act, 1971
Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) Act, 1977
final_judgment: Appeal decided; findings on record examined; resumption of land for public purpose upheld or set aside based on compliance with statutory safeguards and payment of compensation; relief granted to appellants or respondents depending on validity of resumption and title establishment.
